title: Lucas Menezes
summary: A young environmental engineering student whose instinct to help becomes both his magnetism and his burden.

blocks.title: Lucas Menezes
blocks.subtitle: He notices need before he notices his own exhaustion.

paragraphs: Lucas is defeated by scale rather than cruelty. The more he helps, the more clearly he sees what remains undone.
His arc is not about caring less. It is about learning that feeling another person's pain does not create an obligation to personally solve everything.

blocks.text: Feeling deeply does not require carrying everything.
